function solve(x::Vector{Union{Float64, Missing}}, width::Int)
    if width <= 0
        throw(ArgumentError("width must be positive"))
    end
    if width > length(x)
        return missing
    end
    
    result = []
    for i in 1:(length(x) - width + 1)
        window = x[i:i+width-1]
        if all(ismissing, window)
            push!(result, missing)
        else
            mean_val = mean(filter(!ismissing, window))
            push!(result, mean_val)
        end
    end
    
    return result
end
